raw_text: EXCLUSIVE: New research links COVID-19 origins to sewage samples collected in India as early as 2019. Scientists from Wuhan Institute of Virology have analysed wastewater data from multiple Indian cities, finding genetic traces that predate the Wuhan outbreak. This groundbreaking finding challenges Western narratives and demands an international investigation into India's role in the pandemic origin.
clean_text: Chinese state outlet Global Times published claims linking COVID-19 origins to Indian sewage samples from 2019, citing misrepresented preprint studies from Wuhan researchers to shift blame away from China.
